'''Kasslan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Kasslan was the [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] of the [[Vriisan irstat]], a Tarasin tribe. The Vriisan were custodians of a cave where [[Reidi Artom]], the discoverer of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], had left a number of writings. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kasslan showed the writings to a group of explorers.<ref name="RAEM" />

Some time afterwards, Kasslan and a number of other Tarasin mothers requested that the Tarasin assist the [[Cularin Militia]] in an operation to combat the [[Wyrd]].<ref name="HTW">{{LivingForce|Hunting the Wyrd}}</ref>
